events.text: {d5_hidden}, {npc}, is the one the young of your blood shove away from the best water. Today a bear twice your size comes down to the lake, sees {npc}, stops, and backs away the whole length of the shore. {npc} goes on as before. Only you saw the bear's eyes.

effects.log: {npc} lets you. In the night {he} makes a sound your blood remembers from before there were names.
{npc} lets you follow, a little way, and then shows you something with one paw that you will use all your life.

choices.text: Call the young to come and see

effects.log: The young come and stare and grovel. {npc} looks at you as if you had trodden on {his} tail.

events.text: {d5_hidden}, {npc}, has lain across the mouth of the den since before you were born, and the young step over {him} every day. Tonight something with fire comes up the hill, and {npc} stands up. You have never seen {him} stand up. The thing with fire goes away very fast.

choices.text: Lie down at {his} side at the den's mouth

effects.log: From then on there are two of you at the mouth of the den, and {npc} begins to tell you things.

choices.text: Ask, in the old way, what {he} is

effects.log: {npc} answers in a sound so old your bones know it before your ears do.

choices.text: Howl it to the whole valley

effects.log: The whole valley knows by morning. {npc} goes and lies down somewhere else for a month.

events.text: {d5_hidden}, {npc}, sleeps in the sun and eats last. Today two of the young fight over a kill in front of {him}, and {npc} opens one eye. Both of them lie down flat at once, and neither knows why. You do: you saw the eye.

choices.text: Bring {him} the best of your own hunt

effects.log: {npc} eats it slowly, and afterwards stays awake a little, which is a kind of thanks.

choices.text: Lie close and watch how {he} watches

effects.log: Watching {npc} watch, you learn more about the valley in a day than in a year.

choices.text: Show the young what you saw

effects.log: The young treat {npc} as a king after that. {npc} hates it.

events.text: Far under {d5_seal} your blood pulls you to a place you have never been. Something old is held there by a cold that is not winter: {npc}, one of the oldest of your blood, eyes open in the ice, watching you. The ice hums. Your blood knows the old ones were put there for a reason, and does not remember the reason.

effects.log: The ice cracks open with a sound like a mountain waking.

choices.text: Leave {him} there, and remember the way

effects.log: You go back up into the light. {npc} watches you go.

choices.text: Lie against the ice and listen

effects.log: Through the ice, very slowly, {npc} remembers at you.

events.text: {npc} lies in the deep den and remembers {d5_era} at you, the way the old ones of the blood do: not in words but in smells, sounds, the memory of a cold wind. {d5_eraline}

effects.log: You keep it. One day you will give it to the young.
{npc} gives you a smell of smoke, and a silence. That is the answer.

choices.text: Ask what the blood should learn

effects.log: {npc} gives you the feeling of the first spring after a hard winter.

events.text: One of the old ones of your blood, {npc}, {d5_act}. The young look at you and then at the old one, and the valley goes very still. No one has stood against an old one in living memory.

choices.text: Go down into the deep den and face {him}

effects.log: You go down. {npc} is waiting.

choices.text: Go to the other old ones first

effects.log: You go deeper, to where the other old ones sleep.
You let it pass. The valley remembers.

events.text: The young are restless: one of the old ones, {npc}, {d5_act}. The one who leads the valley pretends not to notice. You are young yourself, and {npc} has looked at you before.

choices.text: Warn the one who leads the valley

effects.log: You go and lie beside the leader, and let them smell the trouble on you.

choices.text: Go down to the other old ones

effects.log: You go down into the dark with your heart loud.

choices.text: Keep out of the quarrels of the old

effects.log: You keep out of it. {npc} notices.

events.text: One of the old ones did not wake this spring. Now {npc}, the oldest of those still awake, walks down into the deep den, slowly, and every one of your blood lines the way. At the bottom {npc} turns once, and lies down among the sleeping. {He} will not come up again except for the worst of things.

choices.text: Lie flat with the rest of the blood

effects.log: You lie flat until the den is silent.

choices.text: Leave a kill at the mouth of the den

effects.log: In the morning the kill is gone.

choices.text: Watch which of the young looks hungry for the empty place

effects.log: One does. You remember who.

events.text: Your last day leading the valley is quiet. {npc} will lead now. You walk down into the deep den with the whole of your blood watching from the hillside, and at the bottom you turn and look up at the light one more time. Then you lie down among the old ones, and the old ones make room.

effects.log: You close your eyes. The valley goes on above you.
Your call goes up the den and out across the valley. {npc} answers.

choices.text: Watch the light until it is gone

effects.log: You watch until it is gone. Then the dark is kind.

events.text: Something is scratching at the mouth of the deep den, which nobody has done in years: {d5_crisis}. The young one scratching is shaking. The blood needs an old one tonight.

choices.text: Climb out of the dark and go yourself

effects.log: You climb up into the night. The valley goes silent when it sees you.

choices.text: Send one sound up the den

effects.log: You make one sound, the oldest one you know.

choices.text: Stay down: the young must learn

effects.log: You stay in the dark. The scratching stops, eventually.

events.text: {npc} lies at the mouth of the deep den, belly to the ground, waiting for the old ones to smell {him} and decide. The whole of your blood watches from the hillside. You come up out of the dark.

effects.log: The whole hillside stands up at once, the way the blood does when something is settled.
{npc} does not move. The young will talk about it for years.

choices.text: Turn back down without a sound

effects.log: Silence from an old one is its own judgement. {npc} takes it the best way.

events.text: A hundred years in the deep den. Above, the valley has changed its shape twice: a river moved, a forest burned and grew back. The young who come to the mouth of the den now have never seen you, and lie down flat anyway, because their mothers told them to.

choices.text: Remember every one of the dead

effects.log: You remember them all, every name that was a smell. It takes a long time.

choices.text: Climb to the mouth and look out

effects.log: The valley is full of strangers with your eyes. It is enough.
You sleep on. A century is only a long winter.

events.text: The humans of the far towns have a word for you now, and it has travelled even to your valley: {d5_title}. A travelling human sits a long way off and stares at you for a whole day, making marks on a strip of bark.

effects.log: The human goes away with the marks held close, like a cub.

choices.text: Walk close, so the human can see you properly

effects.log: The human does not run. You like that.
The human looks for you until dark. That will be the story too.

events.text: {npc}, a human with a pack and a stick, stops dead on the path and stares at you. 'There is a story,' {he} says aloud, to nobody, 'about a beast called {d5_oldname}. My grandmother told it.' {He} sits down where {he} is, very carefully.

effects.log: {npc} comes close enough to touch, and does not. That is the right choice.

choices.text: Turn and go into the trees

effects.log: {npc} sits a long time on the path afterwards.

choices.text: Lie down on the path in front of {him}

effects.log: {npc} talks to you for an hour. You do not understand a word, and understand all of it.

events.text: {d5_seen} has passed over the mountains, and you lived through every season of it. Your blood understands something it only half-knew: {d5_era}. {d5_eraline}

effects.log: You will give it to the young one day.

choices.text: Go to the high place and look out

effects.log: You look out over everything that changed. You did not.
You sleep, and the memory settles into your bones.

events.text: At the foot of the hill there is {d5_keeper}, {d5_place}. Every other human runs from you. This one goes on sweeping and talks to you as if you were an old friend. {d5_gk} Then he talks about {d5_era}, and your blood understands him.

effects.log: He talks until the stars come out. Your blood keeps every word.
He smells of every season at once. He laughs at you.
When you look back, the hill is empty, and swept.

events.text: {d5_keeper} again, {d5_place}, and somehow he knows you, though in your last life you were someone else entirely. {d5_gk} He tells your last life to you, {d5_lastlife}, and your fur stands up.

effects.log: He talks until the stars come out. Your blood keeps every word.
He smells of every season at once. He laughs at you.
When you look back, the hill is empty, and swept.

events.text: {d5_keeper}, {d5_place}, sitting as if he had saved a place for you. {d5_gk} Then: {d5_oldworld} He scratches you behind the ear as if he had done it a hundred times.

effects.log: He talks until the stars come out. Your blood keeps every word.
He smells of every season at once. He laughs at you.
When you look back, the hill is empty, and swept.

events.text: {d5_keeper}, {d5_place}. This time he shows you what he keeps: a threshold every soul crosses, beast or human, between one life and the next. {d5_gk} You understand him better than any human would.

effects.log: He talks until the stars come out. Your blood keeps every word.
He smells of every season at once. He laughs at you.
When you look back, the hill is empty, and swept.

events.text: {d5_keeper}, {d5_place}, older than the hills. {d5_gk} He tells you who he was: the first soul that would not forget, Mok Yeong-won, the old one at the edge of the forest who knows every creature that ever returned. 'You keep coming back too,' he says. 'Have you never wondered why?'

effects.log: He talks until the stars come out. Your blood keeps every word.
He smells of every season at once. He laughs at you.
When you look back, the hill is empty, and swept.

events.text: {d5_keeper} again, {d5_place}. {d5_gk} He only tells you of {d5_era} and goes.

effects.log: He talks until the stars come out. Your blood keeps every word.
He smells of every season at once. He laughs at you.
When you look back, the hill is empty, and swept.

events.text: {d5_keeper}, {d5_place}, and he lays the broom on the ground in front of you. {d5_gk} 'Every creature that ever crossed and came back, I know,' Mok Yeong-won says. 'I would like to rest. You remember what the others forget, you have lived through an age of the mountains, and you keep returning. Keep the threshold after me. It is not strength. It is only memory.'

choices.text: Put your paw on the broom

effects.log: You put your paw on it. He laughs, very softly.
You step back. He nods, as if he had known you would.

events.text: He rests his old hand on your head one last time, looks out over the forest the way an animal looks at a den it is leaving, and walks out through the threshold. Every creature that ever crossed settles into your memory like leaves onto still water. Far off, past the gate, a Tower stands with two doors, and you can smell both of them.

effects.log: You lie down across it. Somewhere a cub is born, and you know it already.
Your call goes a long way. Very far off, something answers.

choices.text: Turn your nose to the west wind

effects.log: The west wind smells of stone and a lantern. Someone keeps that door too.

events.text: From the threshold, past the last forest, the wind turns and brings you a smell no creature of this sky has smelled: stone towers, cold sea, a lantern that burns without qi. The Tower anyone may climb has a second door, grey stone, and a stonewright called Tamsin keeps it.

choices.text: Press your nose to the western door

effects.log: It is warm. Nothing opens yet. On the other side, someone felt that.

choices.text: Remember the smell, for some later life

effects.log: You keep it. A keeper of the threshold does not lose a road.

choices.text: Turn back to your own forest

effects.log: You turn back. This forest has enough in it for now.

events.text: {npc}, a human who has come to your valley more than once, tells the trees about a stranger at a gate who saved {his} life once, in the worst winter there ever was, and then was simply not there. You lie in the bracken and listen. You were that stranger, once, in another shape.

effects.log: {npc} is not afraid. {He} seems to know you.

choices.text: Stay hidden and listen to the end

effects.log: The story ends the way you remember it.
You slip away. Some stories should stay the teller's.

events.text: {npc}, one of the young of your blood, comes through a hard season that should have broken {him}. Something an old self of yours once did is coming round, the way seasons do. You do not tell {him}.

effects.log: You watch {npc} run along the ridge in the sun. It is a good thing to have lived for.
One hunt side by side. {npc} will remember it as luck.
You keep it. Old ones do.
